title: A pulsing notification dot
summary: A ::after ring that scales up and fades out on a loop, behind a dot that stays still.
explanation: The dot itself never moves. Its ::after is a copy of the dot, positioned exactly over it (inset: 0). @keyframes ping scales that copy to 2.5 times its size while fading opacity to 0, then the loop starts again, so a ring seems to radiate outwards.
Keeping the real dot still matters: the eye can still read the dot's position and colour while the ring draws attention.
Constant motion is distracting, so a real app would stop the pulse after a few runs (animation-iteration-count: 3) or once the user has seen it. The reduced-motion rule removes it entirely.
tryThis: Change infinite to 3: the pulse stops after three rings.
Remove opacity: 0 from the to step: the ring grows but never fades.
